question: What is the effect of initiation on personal ignorance and personal knowledge?
premises: Initiation and related rites can destroy personal ignorance.
The destruction of ignorance does not always yield immediate full manifestation.
Personal knowledge may become fully clear at the end of the body.
inference: Therefore initiation destroys personal ignorance, yet the corresponding personal knowledge is clearly manifested at the end of that body.
plain_english: Through initiation and similar means, personal ignorance is destroyed. Even so, the corresponding personal knowledge becomes clearly manifest at the end of that body.
